definitionZh: 当用户在容器中滚动时，QVirtualScroll 组件会呈现一个大的项目列表，保持 DOM 树干净并占用尽可能少的内存。
sourceDefinition: The QVirtualScroll component renders a big list of items as the user scrolls in the container, keeping DOM tree clean and eating the lowest amount of memory possible.
